title: Briefing for 2026-11-05
intro: Good morning. Here is your briefing for 2026-11-05: US markets, global news, and the Philippines, in five minutes.
us: The economy brought Trump back to power. Now it's his downfall. Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it. Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms. Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report. Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation. Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts.
global: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat. US midterm results a 'victory' for Canadians hopeful of tariff relief. Ukraine says bodycam video shows deadly Russian double-tap bombing. 'Most difficult days of my life' for keeper Owono. Israel's president begins consultations with parties after election deadlock. Secret police files released in Hungary, 37 years after fall of communism.
philippines: Why Ralph Sarmiento refused to testify at Sara Duterte’s trial. Tencent rolls out AI model trained with limited cybersecurity data amid hacking fears. [Good Business] Sari-sari stores: Kapwa at play amid economic crises. Inflation surges to 7.8% in October 2026 as fuel prices, fares climb.
outro: That's your briefing. Have a great day.
